Change the colours, sounds, text and animations.
Scan beep, sale sound, vibration and the scan popup.
Everything the app plays or buzzes when you scan and when you sell.
The typeface and how large the text is drawn.
Scales all the text in the app, with every screen keeping its proportions.
Transition speed, the startup screen and the sale animation.
How the app moves: transitions, the startup screen and the sale flourish.
Background, buttons, panels, text and highlights.
Background, button, panel, text and highlight colours.
Ready-made palettes, or your own saved sets of all four colours. Picking one applies it straight away.
No saved themes yet. Set the four colours below, then save them as a theme.
Save current colours as a theme
Saves the four colours shown below under one name.
"%1$s" will be removed from your themes. The colours currently in use stay exactly as they are.
Replaces the app background and the panels that hold list items.
Used by buttons, chips, the floating action button and highlights.
The cards and sections that sit on top of the background.
Used for every label, value and heading in the app.
Used for selected filters, the selected tab indicator and emphasised headings.
Changes the typeface used throughout the app.
Colour changes are not applied yet
Previewing is kept separate from applying so the picker stays smooth. Tap Apply to use these colours across the app.
Inventory data is stored on this device only.
Exports the entire database — categories, products, orders and every sale line — as a single JSON file, and restores it again.
The file contains raw values (cents, basis points, epoch milliseconds) so another program can read it without guessing. Use Share to send it straight to a computer.
It contains %1$d categories, %2$d products, %3$d orders and %4$d sale lines.
Supplies: %1$d providers, %2$d materials, %3$d entries and %4$d entry lines.
Restoring overwrites the stock quantities, products, orders and sales currently on this device. Your appearance and language settings are left alone.
Some rows in the file could not be read and will be skipped: %1$s
Replaces this phone\'s colours, font, text size, language, startup screen and scanner sound settings with the ones in the backup.
The export folder and any custom sound or startup image files stay as they are on this device — they live here, not in the file.
That backup has no categories, products or sales in it.
How quickly screens and panels transition. Turn this off to remove every animation.
The spinning icon shown while the app loads.
Pick a PNG or JPG from your device. A logo or icon with a transparent background works best.
A Lottie animation (.json or .lottie) plays on its own, so the spin and circle settings do not apply to it. If the file holds several animations, the first one is used.
That file is not a Lottie animation
Used when no picture is chosen.
The disc drawn behind your image. None places the image directly on the background.
Animated GIFs play as well as still images.
That GIF could not be used. Try a smaller one.
The beep, the popup and how often the camera accepts a scan.
Beep when an item is scanned
Tap a sound to hear it. Pick your own file to use anything on the device.
How the camera behaves while it is open.
How long before the label already in front of the camera can be counted again. Keep this high so one product is not added twice.
How long before the next product can be read. Keep this short so working through a basket stays quick.
A small banner over the camera with the product name and its photo.
Vibrate when an item is scanned
Tap a pattern to feel it. Useful in a noisy shop where the beep is hard to hear.
Plays when a sale is paid for. Tap a sound to hear it, or pick your own file.
Play a sound when a sale is completed
The picture shown when a sale is completed. Tap one to preview it.
How large the picture is on the receipt.
Import a Lottie file (.json or .lottie) to use instead of the pictures above. It plays on the receipt in place of them. If the file holds several animations, the first one is used.
That file is not a Lottie animation
Preview — how it looks on the receipt
Fades the screen to black behind the receipt so the amount stands out.
How hard the phone buzzes. Not every device can change this.
This device has no vibration motor, so this setting has no effect here.
Reset the sound and vibration settings
Exports will be saved to the selected folder
Could not keep access to that folder
Exports will be saved to that folder until the app restarts
Sale cancelled · %1$d item(s) returned to stock
Products in this category stay in inventory but become uncategorised.
Rename, add or delete the categories used to group your products.
No categories yet. Add one below.
A second way to label products, independent of their category.
A product can carry several tags — fragile, clearance, to restock — where it has only one category. Hidden until you switch this on; anything you tag is kept if you switch it off again.
Labels you can put on any product. A product can have several.
No tags yet. Add one above to start labelling products.
\"%1$s\" will be removed from every product it is on. The products themselves are not deleted.
Optional labels for this product. Several can be selected.
No tags yet — create some from the inventory settings.
A total of %1$s was taken across %2$d sales today.
The best seller was %1$s, with %2$d units contributing %3$s.
Sale removed, but %1$s no longer exists so its stock was not restored
Choose the language used by the app.
Scan a product or pick one from inventory
Point the camera at a QR code to add it to the cart
Scan products or add them from the inventory list.
All items in the cart will be removed.
Applied to every sale and deducted from the total.
Tax and card fee are both deducted from the sale total. The card fee only applies to card payments, and is the percentage plus the fixed fee per transaction.
Create a promo to discount a category or a set of products when enough are bought.
The cart must hold at least this many units from the products above. Different products count towards the same total.
Leave the dates empty to keep the promo running until you switch it off.
%1$s will be removed. Past sales that used it keep their discount.
Restoring a backup that contains promos switches those discounts back on for the dates they cover.
Off: a single .json file with the data only. Photos stay on this device.
On: a .zip file with the data and every product photo, so a restore on another device brings the photos too.
The symbol shown in front of every amount.
Prices are stored as plain numbers, so changing the symbol relabels them rather than converting them. If you are switching to a different currency, re-enter the prices too.
How amounts are shown. Prices are always stored exactly, so nothing changes when you switch this.
The whole app will use this language. You can change it later in Settings.
Which currency do you sell in?
This sets the symbol shown in front of every amount. It labels your prices — it does not convert them.
Cents are always stored exactly, so switching this off only changes what is shown, not what you have.

This transfer is not encrypted. Use it on a network you trust, like your own shop or home Wi-Fi. Do not leave the connection open when you are finished.
Android is blocking local network access for this app. Allow nearby devices (local network) in Android settings so the computer can reach this phone.
Starts a temporary server on this phone. Enter the address and code below in your computer app. The computer can then send a backup here, or download this phone\'s data, including product photos.
The server stops by itself after one successful transfer, or after five minutes with no connection.
Transfer complete. The server has stopped.
Backup downloaded by the computer. The server has stopped.
Waiting for the computer to connect…
Port %1$s is already in use on this phone. Close the other app using it, or try again.
